title: feat(metadata-core): export the schema upgrade verdict and its finding set token, so a host's install door forwards the platform's own verdict
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP1hxu6zzAV6eVFttJkDXKPW)_

Fixes #31526

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/metadata-core`** gains `src/package-upgrade-verdict.ts`, exported from the index next to `package-upgrade-plan.ts`. It contains:
  - `schemaUpgradeVerdict(packageId, plan)` → `{ findings, findingSet }`. These need confirming:
    - a suspected rename, always;
    - a type change in the `needs_confirm` or `destructive` drift category, including on a declared rename.

    These are not findings: a declared rename, a removed field or object, a `safe` type change, a seed change.
  - `installedRecordUnavailableVerdict(packageId, finding)`: the verdict for a door that has no installed side to compare. It returns one confirmable finding, never "no finding". The finding's sentence stays the door's own.
  - `schemaUpgradeFindingSet(packageId, findings)`: the token. It is `schema-upgrade:` followed by 32 hex characters of a SHA-256 over the package id and the findings' sorted identities.
  - Constants: `SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, `SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_STATUS`, `SCHEMA_UPGRADE_TOPIC`, `SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMED_CATEGORIES`.
  - Types: `SchemaUpgradeFinding`, `SchemaUpgradeUnavailableFinding`, `SchemaUpgradeVerdict`.
- **`@objectstack/cloud-connection`**: the install-local door now imports all of the above, and the moved code is verbatim. The door keeps only `ledgerRecordUnavailableVerdict`, its sentence for an install record that is unreadable or missing; that function now calls the exported `installedRecordUnavailableVerdict`. `createHash` and three type imports the door no longer uses are dropped.
- **`@objectstack/spec`**: one `PROVENANCE_WAIVERS` entry, because the provenance gate attributes a constant to the package that defines it. `SCHEMA_UPGRADE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` is now defined in metadata-core but stays registered under `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, whose door puts it on the wire. This follows the `UPDATE_ID_MISMATCH` shape. No ledger row is added or moved.

## Why

cloud#3654 (epic cloud#3652, ruling Q3 「默认拒绝，需显式映射（推荐）」) has the hosted install door refuse an undeclared rename or a type change "with the framework's code and finding-set token". Its card forbids cloud from re-judging.

Before this PR, the verdict and the token were private to `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, so the hosted door could only copy the judgement or refuse nothing. With the export, both doors apply one rule and mint one token: the same pair of versions gets the same findings and the same token, whichever door installs it.

The hosted consumer is cloud#3861.

## Verification

Run in a worktree at `origin/main` `4cd48e27` plus this branch. The workspace dependencies' `dist/` were borrowed from a build of objectstack `3c380253` (27 commits behind main), and `metadata-core` was rebuilt from this branch.

- `packages/metadata-core`: `vitest run src/package-upgrade-verdict.test.ts src/package-upgrade-plan.test.ts` gives 2 files, 27 tests passed. The new test file pins two token values, both computed with the door's original digest before the move, so the test pins byte identity:
  - `schema-upgrade:a168d8927e7a5afc25f947ee715fa848`: a one-field suspected rename on `com.acme.deals`;
  - `schema-upgrade:c29494e0b3b3e33a84adf0c2188baa37`: the empty set.
- `packages/cloud-connection`: `vitest run` on the three install-local suites that exercise the gate (`marketplace-install-local-upgrade-plan`, `-corrupt-ledger`, `-declared-rename`) gives 3 files, 47 tests passed, unchanged.
- `packages/spec`: `check:error-code-provenance` OK (11 waivers, all live). `src/api/error-code-ledger.test.ts` gives 26 tests passed.
- `tsc --noEmit` is clean in `metadata-core` (both configs) and in `cloud-connection`. eslint is clean on the changed source files.
- `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-doc-authoring` all pass.
- Docs drift comment: the two pages it names (`data-modeling/fields.mdx` and `deployment/cli.mdx`) describe the install-local refusal and `renamedFrom`. Their behaviour is unchanged by a verbatim move, so neither needs an edit.

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

This is widening only: `@objectstack/metadata-core` gains the exports listed above. No request, answer, key or error code changes on any door. The changeset is graded `patch`, since the protocol kind is none.
